review_evidence: README identifies a Lean formalization of generalization bounds via Rademacher complexity and Dudley entropy integrals, tied to arXiv:2503.19605.
Forty-two of 45 Lean files contain proposition declarations covering symmetrization, concentration, entropy, RKHS/linear models, contraction and ERM excess-risk bounds.
The documented public API names end-to-end generalization theorems and reusable probability/learning lemmas; this is substantive mathematical prior art.
summary: Reviewed lean-rademacher; retain its substantial statistical-learning-theory formalization.
